mass_handling: With zero user static masses, CometSearchManager assigns B/J/X/Z residue masses of 999999, outside the frozen 600-5000-Da peptide mass range. Peptides containing these uncertain residues are therefore unsearchable under the fixed settings, while other segments of the same reference proteins remain included. U and O have defined masses.
stop_handling: Explicit stop characters are retained by the FASTA reader and recognized as enzyme boundaries; target strings contain no stops.
specificity_limitation: Literal/I-L nonmatches do not rule out matches hidden by X/B/Z or other ambiguous source residues. No guessed residue expansions are used.
